decisionBox.changed: The midday reduce trigger (81,590) never confirmed: every 1H close since stayed at or above 81,600, and the wick to 81,453 reversed. The bias stays bearish but the bounce held, so confidence drops to 5.0. The wallet sells another quarter of its spot for the overnight gap.

overnightRisk: Next report is about 02:00 COT. Catalysts: US equities fell hard today (QQQ -1.97%, VOO -1.09%), so Asia opens risk-off; Tokyo/JPXN already -1.26%. Longs are crowded (1H long/short ratio 1.77, OI $2.58B, funding barely positive) and $1.26M of longs were flushed at 81.4k-81.6k in the last 100 realized fills, so a break of 81,450 has room to run into 81,033 and 80,400 with thin overnight liquidity. A resting stop at 81,400 is the only protection while nobody is watching. Daily RSI 46.7 and 1H RSI 33 leave room for an oversold bounce to 82.0k-82.35k first.

liquidation.note: About $1.05M of LONG liquidations at 81.6k in the newest 100 OKX realized fills (21:03Z-23:01Z), plus $0.14M at 81.4k and $0.07M at 81.5k. Longs keep getting flushed into the low.
About $0.004M of SHORT liquidations at 81.6k-81.9k in the same fills: negligible squeeze fuel.
